injuries.detail: Diabate (quadriceps) has been downgraded to out for Monday's game against Cleveland.
Williams (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Miller (groin) is listed as out for Monday's game against Cleveland.
Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Hornets.
Tyson (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Hornets.
